title: Hypothetical blank-check project and an opera
summary: He would not repeat Focus but would write an opera.

story.theme_name: Writing and arranging: how musicians compose
story.community_name: Critics, polls and the jazz press

blocks.x: It's a nice syrupy sound. Here's a hypothetical question for you. If somebody came to you and said here's a project, whatever the budget is I'll pay for it, do whatever you want--
He put it in those terms, more or less?
No budget, just do whatever you want.
In other words, he wasn't limiting you to a Focus_type thing necessarily?
So you really don't have any firm ideas what you would do in that kind of a situation?

don't want to repeat what I've done now three times, or four times. I don't want to do it and there has to be some other way to do it. I could do it with a jumping brass section except I feel that I'm away from that. It would be an exercise for me; that doesn't seem right to put on a record. It's something I could do in another context, TV or something like that, but not here, not for a record.
My lifestyle has to somehow fit that.

One guy on a show the other day said if someone came to you and said we'll support you for the next year and a half or two years to write an opera, would you do it, hypothetically, and I thought and I said yeah, I would do it, I'd take a shot at it. If it were presented that way. I don't know if I could pull it off, but I certainly would try. I would want to do something like that now.
All my life I wished I could get in a situation where I didn't have to worry about (inaudible). I never wanted to be rich or powerful, that was never part of the plan, but I always did want to live.
